entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call is important to us. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hi there, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi Sarah... I hope you can help. I need to make a return, but I'm worried it might be too late. I just feel so let down.
I'm sorry to hear that. I can definitely look into this for you. Could I get your name and order number to start?
Yes, it's Alex Miller, order number VF-78901. It's about a jersey I bought. I've been a customer for so long, and I've never had a problem before.
Thank you, Alex. I see your account here, and we really appreciate your loyalty. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the jersey?

It's the wrong size. I ordered my usual medium, but it's just way too tight across the shoulders. I was so excited for my race this month, and now I can't even wear it. I was hoping I could exchange it for a large.
Okay, thank you for clarifying. So it's a fit issue, not a tear or anything like that. Let me just pull up your order details... I see it was delivered 33 days ago.
I know, I know... I feel so bad. With work being so busy, I didn't get to try it on right away. I really needed that money back if I can't get an exchange. It's just been a rough month.

Alex, please don't worry about it at all. For standard apparel like a jersey, you're well within our 90-day return window. We can absolutely process an exchange for you or a full refund, whichever you prefer.
Oh, really? That's... that's such a relief. I was so stressed about it. Thank you so much.

Of course. And because this was a frustrating experience and you're a VIP customer, I'm going to email you a return label right now and I've also added a voucher for complimentary express shipping on your next order. You can use that to get the correct size sent out to you much faster.
Wow, Sarah, that's incredibly kind. You've completely turned my day around. Thank you!
You're very welcome, Alex. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that was everything. Thanks again!
My pleasure. Have a wonderful day and happy riding!
